q: Sales fell 50% last year and rose 50% this year. Compared with two years ago, they are…
why: 0.5 × 1.5 = 0.75. The 50% rise works on a smaller base than the 50% fall did.

q: A price including 20% VAT is 96. Find the price before VAT.
why: The 20% is of the price BEFORE VAT, not of 96. 96 = 1.2 × P, so P = 80.

q: x% of y is equal to y% of x.
why: x/100 × y = y/100 × x. So 8% of 50 is the same as 50% of 8, which is 4.

q: 0.5% is the same as one half.
why: Myth. 0.5% = 0.005, which is one two-hundredth. One half is 50%.

q: Three 10% rises in a row add up to a 30% rise.
why: 1.1³ = 1.331, so it's a 33.1% rise. It is always more than 30%, because each rise works on a bigger base.
